# JSON

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/json-field` (named export `JsonField`). Primitive arbitrary-JSON field for structured payloads that don't warrant their own FieldDef (webhook payloads, config blobs).

## Usage
```ts
import { JsonField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/json-field';
```

Example: value `{"retries": 3, "active": true}`
